episodes.title: Dragon Ball: Curse of the Blood Rubies
episodes.summary: Goku and his friends must stop King Gurumes from destroying the city for blood rubies and gathering the seven Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball: Sleeping Princess in Devil's Castle
episodes.summary: Goku and Krillin want to be trained by the great Master Roshi. He only agrees to train them by sending them to the Devil's Castle to rescue the Sleeping Princess, who is being held prisoner there by Count Lucifer.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball: Mystical Adventure
episodes.summary: Goku and Krillin are invited to participate in a martial arts tournament taking place in the country of Mifan, where a desperate emperor needs help.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball: The Path to Power
episodes.summary: Goku and friends go to an adventure searching for the legendary Dragon Balls, as they fight against the Red Ribbon army.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Dead Zone
episodes.summary: Gohan is kidnapped by Garlic Jr.'s men so he can have Gohan's Dragon Ball to grant him immortality. Goku and his friends try to stop Garlic Jr. and save the world.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: The World's Strongest
episodes.summary: The Z-Fighters must stop a mad scientist and his assistant that are out to take over the world.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: The Tree of Might
episodes.summary: A group of aliens visit Earth to plant the Tree of Might, a plant that grants cosmic power by draining the Earth's life force.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Lord Slug
episodes.summary: A Super Namekian named Lord Slug comes to invade Earth and only Goku can stop him .

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Cooler's Revenge
episodes.summary: Frieza's older brother Cooler travels to Earth to take revenge against Goku for Frieza's defeat on planet Namek.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: The Return of Cooler
episodes.summary: Cooler has resurrected himself as a robot and is enslaving the people of New Namek. Goku and the gang must help.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Super Android 13!
episodes.summary: The death of Dr. Gero at the hands of Androids 17 and 18 prompts the activation of Androids 13, 14, and 15. They try to kill Goku, who fights them with the help of Trunks, Piccolo, Vegeta, Krillin, and Gohan.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Broly - The Legendary Super Saiyan
episodes.summary: Goku, Vegeta, and the rest of the Dragon Team search for the fabled Legendary Super Saiyan, a destructive, all-powerful warrior.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Bojack Unbound
episodes.summary: Bojack is a demon who was freed from prison when King Kai's planet was destroyed. Now, without his father Goku by his side, can Gohan save the Earth?

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Broly - Second Coming
episodes.summary: After seven years went by, Gohan grows up during the time around Goten's birth. Goku died and when Goten cries, Broly regains life and the Z warriors must stop him again.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Bio-Broly
episodes.summary: Broly is cloned by Lord Jaguar, who plans to pit him and other bio-warriors against Mr. Satan in an attempt to expose him as a fraud. Goten, Trunks, Kriilin and Android 18 must stop the new Bio-Broly.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Fusion Reborn
episodes.summary: The universe is thrown into dimensional chaos as the dead come back to life. Now Goku and Vegeta must track down the cause of this uproar.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Wrath of the Dragon
episodes.summary: The Z-fighters find themselves in the middle of another extraterrestrial conflict, which includes a sword-wielding warrior named Tapion, a wizard and an enormous monster named Hirudegarn.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods
episodes.summary: After sleeping for 39 years, the God of destruction Beerus is surprised to learn that Frieza was defeated by the saiyajin Goku. Upon finding him, Goku is excited to face him, but realizes that his powers are negligible compared to Beerus.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection 'F'
episodes.summary: Frieza is reborn and achieves the last of his transformations, and it is up to Goku and his warrior friends to join forces to fight the enemy who has returned from the dead.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Super: Broly
episodes.summary: Goku and Vegeta encounter Broly, a Saiyan warrior unlike any fighter they've faced before.

episodes.title: Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero
episodes.summary: The Red Ribbon Army from Goku's past has returned with two new androids to challenge him and his friends.
